## Why Repository Access Matters

The PRD2Case fallback API can generate a broad draft from the PRD text alone, but the full `prd2case-web` workflow requires repository and environment context to resolve:

- route provenance: app basename + real route config
- real executable page URL
- current API wrapper and request fields
- live sample data / TDRS status
- one-to-one `test_analysis.md` analysis IDs
- final `case.md` grammar compliance

Without repository access, this run should be treated as PRD-derived case exploration, not a final executable WebE2E suite.
